text:
𝗕𝗥𝗢𝗢𝗞 𝟲𝟱 𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗠𝗖𝗚! 🏏

England were past 160 after 17 overs in the 1st T20I vs Australia.
Harry Brook made 65; Nikhil Chaudhary took 2/21.

Can Australia chase it? 👇
#AUSvENG #Cricket
